defects.title: Every CAD generation step halts with ErrorType.FATAL because cadpy/step_scene.py imports TDF_LabelSequence, which OCP 8 (pulled by unpinned build123d) no longer provides
defects.expected_behavior: The CAD coder imports its geometry runtime and generates the requested part (or reports a clear, actionable dependency error) instead of halting every step at iteration 0.
defects.observed_behavior: In both rounds all 5 steps return 'Status: HALTED (ErrorType.FATAL) Iterations: 0'; the pipeline QA output carries ImportError: cannot import name 'TDF_LabelSequence' from 'OCP.TDF' (step_scene.py:32). The same failure appears on a second Case (52bea90e) in 2/2 rounds on the same source. Reproduction: 2 of 2 valid rounds on this source (c7f6b3f18247); 4 of 4 across two Cases.
